original: じゃあ、セネル君も行けないのね
traducao: So you can't go either, Senel?

original: 個人的には、ぴったりの仕事だと\n思ったんだけど……
traducao: I personally thought this job\nwould be perfect for you, but...

original: 悪いな。\n今回だけは、どうしても外せない\n用事があるんだ
traducao: Sorry.\nI have something I absolutely\ncan't get out of right now.

original: それじゃあ、しょうがないね
traducao: Well, it can't be helped then.

original: ……と、言ってるところに\n○○。\nちょうど良かった
traducao: ...Oh, speak of the devil,\nhere's ○○!\nPerfect timing.

original: あなた向きの仕事の話が\n来ているんだけど。\n受けてみる気はない？
traducao: We've got a job that's right up\nyour alley.\nWould you like to take it?

original: 本当なら、俺が行きたいところなんだが。\nこっちはこっちで、急ぎの用が出来てな
traducao: I'd really like to go myself, but\nI've got an urgent matter to deal with.

original: 人を探さなきゃいけないんだ
traducao: I need to find someone.

original: もし手が空いてるなら、\nアンジュの依頼を\n手伝ってもらえると助かる
traducao: If you're free,\nI'd appreciate it if you could\nhelp Ange with her request.

original: クエスト「不埒な悪漢を倒せ！」が\nエントリーされました。\nクエストカウンタから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: The quest "Defeat the Outrageous Thug!"\nhas been added.\nYou can accept it at the Quest Counter.

original: 行ってくれるのね。\nありがとう
traducao: You'll go?\nThank you.

original: 多分、相手は単なるゴロツキの類だから\n追い払うのに苦労はしないと思うけど
traducao: It's probably just a common thug,\nso it should be easy to chase them away.

original: もし危なくなったら、\n無理をしないで戻って来てね
traducao: If things get dangerous,\nplease don't push yourself and come back.

original: それじゃ、気を付けて\n行ってらっしゃい
traducao: Well then, be careful\nand good luck.

original: チッ！\nおい、向こうへ逃げたぞ！！
traducao: Tch!\nHey, they ran that way!!

original: 回り込んで囲え！　畳み掛けろ！！
traducao: Circle around! Don't let up!!

original: ふう、撒いたか……
traducao: Phew, did I lose them...?

original: お前……何者だ？\nあいつらの仲間か
traducao: Who are you?\nAre you with them?

original: おい、そっちにはいたか？
traducao: Hey, were they over there?

original: いや、こっちはダメだ。\n向こうも探してみるぞ
traducao: No, nothing here.\nLet's check the other way.

original: くっ……、次から次へと！
traducao: Ugh... one after another!

original: おい、お前！\n次に会った時はこうはいかないからな
traducao: Hey, you!\nIt won't be this easy next time we meet!

original: くっ……強い……！
traducao: Ugh... you're strong...!

original: だが、こんな所で\n私が挫けるわけには……！
traducao: But I can't let myself\nbe defeated in a place like this...!

original: ……何……誤解、だと？
traducao: ...What... A misunderstanding, you say?

original: どういう事だ？
traducao: What do you mean?

original: すると、何だ……
traducao: So, you're saying...

original: 私は、人助けに来た貴公を\n悪党と間違えて襲ってしまったと……
traducao: I mistook you for a thug while you\nwere trying to help people and attacked...

original: そ、そうだったのか……すまない。\n私はてっきり……
traducao: I-I see... I'm sorry.\nI completely thought...

original: いや……そちらの事情も知った以上\nここで何もせずに引き下がっては\n義にもとる
traducao: No... knowing your circumstances,\nit would be unjust of me to\nback down without doing anything.

original: どうだろう。\n私も貴公と共にそのギルドで働かせては\nもらえないだろうか？
traducao: What do you say?\nWould you allow me to work at\nthat guild alongside you?

original: 驚く事はないだろう？
traducao: There's no need to be surprised, right?

original: 困っている人を助けるのは、\n騎士として当然の務めなのだからな
traducao: Helping those in need is\na knight's natural duty, after all.

original: それに、貴公には借りもある
traducao: Besides, I owe you a debt.

original: 私はクロエ。\nクロエ・ヴァレンスだ。\n貴公の名は？
traducao: I am Chloe.\nChloe Valens.\nWhat is your name?

original: そうか、○○というのだな
traducao: I see. You're called ○○.

original: では改めて、よろしく頼む。\n○○
traducao: Then, once again, I'm counting on you.\n○○.

original: ここがバンエルティア号……。\n噂には聞いていたが……
traducao: So this is the Van Eltia...\nI've heard rumors about it, but...

original: お前……クロエじゃないか！\n何をしてるんだ、こんな所で
traducao: You... Chloe!\nWhat are you doing in a place like this?

original: クーリッジ！？\n……それにレイナード！
traducao: Coolidge!?\n...And Raynard too!

original: どうやら、お前の用事も\nあっけなく片付いた様だな
traducao: It seems your business was\ntaken care of rather easily, Senel.

original: ああ。\n相変わらず手のかかる……
traducao: Yeah.\nShe's a handful as always, Chloe...

original: クロエ、お前の所へ\n鳩を飛ばしたはずだが、\n見なかったのか？
traducao: Chloe,\nI sent a pigeon to your place,\ndidn't you see it?

original: 鳩？
traducao: A pigeon?

original: 私は、先の戦いからここへ\n戻ったばかりで……
traducao: I just returned here\nfrom my previous battle...

original: じゃあ、まだ見ていないのか
traducao: So you haven't seen it yet.

original: どうりで……
traducao: No wonder...

original: 見事に、行き違いになったという事か
traducao: It seems you missed each other entirely.

original: だが、こうして合流出来て何よりだ。\nアンジュもきっと歓迎するだろう
traducao: But it's good we could meet up like this.\nAnge will surely welcome you.

original: そうだな。\n無鉄砲だが、クロエは腕が立つからな
traducao: Yeah.\nShe's reckless, but Chloe is skilled.

original: む、無鉄砲は余計だ！
traducao: R-Reckless is uncalled for, Senel!

original: ここから先は我々が引き継ごう
traducao: We'll take over from here.

original: ○○、\nクロエをここまで\n案内してくれたのだろう？
traducao: ○○,\nyou guided Chloe\nhere, didn't you?

original: すまなかったな
traducao: Sorry about that.

original: 大丈夫だったか？\nこいつ、いきなり襲いかかったり\nしてくる事があるからな
traducao: Are you okay?\nShe tends to attack people\nout of nowhere.

original: 「不埒な誘拐犯め、\n　根性を叩き直してやる！」\n……だったか？
traducao: "You outrageous kidnapper,\nI'll beat some sense into you!"\n...Something like that?

original: うう、うるさい！
traducao: S-Shut up!

original: はは。\nまぁ、無事で良かった
traducao: Haha.\nWell, I'm glad you're safe.

original: 故郷が戦争に負けてから、\n何の音沙汰もないから\n心配したぞ
traducao: I hadn't heard from you\nsince our homeland lost the war,\nso I was worried.

original: す……すまない……。\n迷惑を、掛けた
traducao: I... I'm sorry...\nFor causing you trouble.

original: そう思うんだったら、\nその分、ここで頑張って働けばいいさ
traducao: If you feel that way,\nthen just work hard here to make up.

original: ああ……そうだな
traducao: Yeah... you're right.

original: ぜひ、そうさせてもらおう
traducao: I'll gladly do so.

original: クロエがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Chloe joined Ad Libitum.

original: お前は、さっきの……！
traducao: You're the one from before...!

original: やはり、貴様もこいつらの\n仲間だったのだな！
traducao: As I thought, you really are\none of their gang!

original: お前の仲間は全て私が退治した。\n残るはお前、ただ一人
traducao: I've taken care of all your comrades.\nYou're the only one left.

original: 罪のない民間人を襲い、\n金品を奪う下劣な行為……
traducao: Attacking innocent civilians\nand stealing... Such despicable acts...

original: その腐った根性ともども、この場で\n叩き直してやる！
traducao: I'll beat some sense into you\nand your rotten nature right here and now!

original: 言い訳など見苦しいぞ！\n覚悟を決めろ、悪党め！！
traducao: Your excuses are pathetic!\nPrepare yourself, you villain!!

original: どうやら、\n一度痛め付けられたくらいでは\n懲りない様だな
traducao: It seems\nyou haven't learned your lesson\nafter being beaten once.

original: お望みとあらば、\n何度でも相手をしてやる
traducao: If you wish,\nI'll take you on as many times as needed.

original: 来い！
traducao: Come!

original: あいつ、また勝手な事を……
traducao: That idiot, doing whatever she wants...

original: ああ、○○か
traducao: Oh, it's you, ○○.

original: いや、ちょっと\n面倒な頼み事をされてさ……
traducao: Well, I just got a\nrather annoying request...

original: 昔の知り合いからなんだが\nこれからブラウニー坑道まで\n迎えに来いって言うんだ
traducao: It's from an old acquaintance.\nShe wants me to come pick her up\nat the Brownie Mine.

original: まぁ、そうやって\nこっちの都合を考えないところが\nいかにもあいつらしいんだが……
traducao: Well, not considering my situation\nat all is just\nso typical of Norma...

original: ……おい。\nまさか、代わりに迎えに行くなんて\n言わないよな？
traducao: ...Hey.\nYou're not going to say you'll go\npick her up instead of me, are you?

original: ……それは……一応あいつも女だし、\nあんな場所に一人でいたら\n危ないかもしれないが
traducao: ...Well... Norma is a girl, after all,\nand it might be dangerous for her\nto be in a place like that alone...

original: あいつは、逃げ足が速いんだ。\n魔物に追いかけられたとしても\n大丈夫だろう。　だから……
traducao: Norma is fast on her feet.\nEven if she gets chased by monsters,\nshe'll probably be fine. So...

original: ……いや、わかった。\n判断は○○に\n任せるよ
traducao: ...Alright, I understand.\nI'll leave the decision to you,\n○○.

original: クエスト「お騒がせ夢盗人」が\nエントリーされました。\nクエストカウンタから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: The quest "The Troublesome Dream Thief"\nhas been added.\nYou can accept it at the Quest Counter.

original: 結局、迎えに行くのか……。\nまぁ、○○なら\nそう言うだろうと思ったよ
traducao: You're really going to pick her up...?\nWell, I figured you'd say that,\n○○.

original: わかったよ、俺も同行する
traducao: Alright, I'll go with you too.

original: 全く、ノーマの奴……。\n会ったら文句の一つも\n言ってやらないとな
traducao: Geez, that Norma...\nI'll have to give her a piece of my mind\nwhen we see her.

original: 全く、よりによって\n何でこんな所にいるんだ、あいつは
traducao: Geez, of all places,\nwhy is Norma here?

original: しかも「お宝探しながら待ってる」って\n何だよ。\nどう考えてもおかしいだろ……
traducao: And what does she mean by\n"waiting while looking for treasure"?\nThat's just completely weird...

original: まっすぐバンエルティア号に\n来ればいいのにな。\nお前もそう思うだろ？
traducao: Norma should have just come straight\nto the Van Eltia.\nDon't you think so too?

original: そういえばあいつ、\nいつもこんな感じなんだよな
traducao: Come to think of it,\nNorma is always like this.

original: ああ、これから迎えに行く奴の話だ。\nノーマっていうんだけどさ
traducao: Yeah, I'm talking about the person\nwe're picking up. Her name is Norma.

original: 勢いだけというか、\n何も考えずに行動するというか……
traducao: She just goes with the flow,\nor acts without thinking...

original: とにかく周りに\n迷惑ばかり掛ける奴でさ
traducao: Anyway, Norma is someone\nwho causes trouble for everyone around.

original: 一番最初に会った時だって、\nあいつ、魔物に追い掛けられてたんだ
traducao: Even when we first met,\nNorma was being chased by monsters.

original: しかも、自分で魔物の巣を荒らしておいて、\nどうして助けなかったのかって\nいきなり文句を言って来て
traducao: And even though she messed up\nthe monster's nest herself,\nshe complained to me for not helping her.

original: そのまま勝手に仲間になるって\n付いて来たんだよな
traducao: Then she just tagged along,\ndeciding to join me on her own.

original: いつもお宝お宝言って、\n色んな物を漁って……。\n毎回、何か厄介な問題を起こすけど
traducao: Norma's always talking about treasure,\nscavenging for things...\nShe always causes some sort of trouble...

original: 不思議と憎めないんだよな……。\n本当、変な奴だよ
traducao: Strangely enough, I can't hate Norma.\nShe's a really weird girl.

original: お、いたいた
traducao: Oh, there she is.

original: おい、ノーマ！\nこんな所で何やってるんだよ
traducao: Hey, Norma!\nWhat are you doing in a place like this?

original: お〜、セネセネじゃん！\n何、どったの〜〜〜？
traducao: Oh~, it's Sene-Sene!\nWhat's up~~~?

original: は？\nお前がアドリビトムに入りたいって\n手紙出してきたんだろ？
traducao: Huh?\nDidn't you send a letter saying\nyou wanted to join Ad Libitum?

original: しかも、こんな所まで\n迎えに来いって！
traducao: And you told me to come pick you up\nin a place like this!

original: そうだっけ？
traducao: Did I?

original: それよりさ、ここ、ここ、ココ！！\n素材がわんさかあるじゃな〜〜い！
traducao: More importantly, here, here, HERE!!\nThere are so many materials here~~~!

original: いひひ〜〜〜、お宝お宝、\nザックザク〜〜〜♪
traducao: Ehehe~~~, treasure, treasure,\njingling all the way~~~!

original: ……………。\nおい、行くぞ
traducao: .........\nHey, let's go.

original: ちょ、ちょっと、待って〜〜〜〜〜！
traducao: W-Wait a minute~~~~~!

original: まだ、あそこの\n岩陰調べてない〜〜〜〜！！！\nセネセネ〜〜〜〜！！！
traducao: I haven't checked behind\nthat rock yet~~~~~!!!\nSene-Sene~~~~~!!!

original: 全く、一人で\nあんな所をうろついて……
traducao: Good grief, wandering around\na place like that by yourself...

original: あの時みたいに、\n魔物に襲われたら\nどうするつもりだったんだよ！
traducao: Like last time,\nwhat were you going to do if you were\nattacked by monsters?!

original: おい！\n聞いてるのか！？
traducao: Hey!\nAre you listening to me?!

original: え、ううん、\n全然聞いてない
traducao: Eh, nope,\nI wasn't listening at all.

original: それよりさ、この船、\nお宝積んでないの？
traducao: More importantly,\ndoes this ship have any treasure?

original: 結構広そうじゃない？\n色々隠し部屋とかあったりして〜〜〜！
traducao: It looks pretty spacious, doesn't it?\nMaybe there are hidden rooms and stuff~~~!

original: ……○○、行くぞ。\n相手するだけ、時間の無駄だ……
traducao: ...○○, let's go.\nDealing with Norma is a waste of time...

original: ノーマがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Norma joined Ad Libitum.

original: ○○！\nいいところに来たキュ！
traducao: ○○!\nYou came at a good time, kyu!

original: ポッポ達は、持ち場を離れられないキュ！\nだから、代わりに行って欲しい所があるキュ！\n……お願い出来ないキュ？
traducao: Poppo and the others can't leave\nour posts, kyu! So we want you\nto go somewhere for us, kyu! ...Can you?

original: ジェイは、とっても強いキュ！\n絶対、みんなの仲間にした方がいいキュ！
traducao: Jay is very strong, kyu!\nYou definitely want Jay on your team, kyu!

original: クエスト「モフモフもふもふ」が\nエントリーされました。\nポッポから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: The quest "Mofu-Mofu Oresoren"\nhas been added.\nYou can accept it from Poppo.

original: 依頼を受けてくれるキュ？\nありがとだキュ！
traducao: You'll accept the request, kyu?\nThank you, kyu!

original: ジェイは今、ルバーブ連山に\nいるみたいだキュ！
traducao: Jay seems to be in the\nRhubarb Mountains right now, kyu!

original: 特徴だキュ？　特徴は……
traducao: Jay's features, kyu? Features...

original: ……ジェイは、ちょっと背が低いキュ。\nでも、あんまり言わないで欲しいキュ……
traducao: ...Jay is a bit short, kyu.\nBut please don't talk about it, kyu...

original: とにかく、ルバーブ連山だキュ。\n気を付けて行ってくるキュ
traducao: Anyway, it's the Rhubarb Mountains, kyu.\nBe careful on your way, kyu.

original: ジェイをよろしく頼むキュ！
traducao: Please take care of Jay, kyu!

original: やっぱり、この辺にはないのか……。\nだとすると、もっと奥に……
traducao: As expected, it's not around here...\nIf so, maybe deeper in...

original: 突然、人の背後には立たない方がいいですよ。\n警戒した相手に攻撃されても、\n何の文句も言えませんからね
traducao: You shouldn't stand right behind someone.\nYou can't complain if someone attacks you\nwhen they're on guard, you know.

original: ああ。\nすみませんが、今手が離せないんです。\nお話でしたら、また次の機会に
traducao: Ah.\nSorry, but I'm busy right now.\nIf you want to talk, next time.

original: 失礼します
traducao: Excuse me.

original: あなたは、先程の……？
traducao: You're the one from earlier...?

original: まさか、ポッポの言っていた、\nアドリビトムの方ですか？
traducao: Are you by any chance\nthe Ad Libitum people Poppo mentioned?

original: そうですか、それは失礼しました
traducao: I see, my apologies then.

original: 初めまして、ぼくがジェイです。\nモフモフ族のみんなが\nお世話になっているそうで
traducao: Nice to meet you, I'm Jay.\nI hear the Oresoren have been\nin your care.

original: ポッポ達のお願いでもあるので、\nぼくもあなた達に協力をしますよ。\n宜しくお願いします
traducao: Since Poppo and the others asked,\nI'll cooperate with you as well.\nI look forward to working with you.

original: それにしても……
traducao: Even so...

original: よくぼくがジェイだとわかりましたね？\nセネルさん達ですら、一度でぼくを\nジェイだと見抜く事は出来なかったのに
traducao: How did you know I was Jay?\nEven Senel and the others couldn't\ntell it was me the first time.

original: 何ですか？\nはっきり言って下さい
traducao: What is it?\nPlease be clear.

original: ……え、身長？
traducao: ...Eh, height?

original: ……それ、誰から聞いたんですか？\n今の話と身長の事は\n何の関係もないでしょう
traducao: ...Who did you hear that from?\nMy height has absolutely nothing\nto do with what we just talked about.

original: それとも、アドリビトムには\n加入条件として身長制限でも\n設けられているんですか？
traducao: Or does Ad Libitum have a\nheight restriction\nfor joining?

original: もういいです。\nお話でしたらそちらで伺います
traducao: That's enough.\nIf you want to talk, let's do it there.

original: さあ、バンエルティア号へ\n案内して下さい
traducao: Now, please guide me to\nthe Van Eltia.

original: ジェイだキュ〜〜〜〜！！
traducao: It's Jay, kyu~~~~!!

original: みんな、無事かい？
traducao: Is everyone okay?

original: 大丈夫だキュ〜！
traducao: We're fine, kyu~!

original: みんな、いい人達だキュ！
traducao: Everyone here is nice, kyu!

original: それは良かった
traducao: That's good.

original: ごめんよ、みんなの好物の\nボルケイノホタテをお土産に\n採ってきたかったんだけど……
traducao: Sorry, I wanted to bring everyone's\nfavorite Volcano Scallop\nas a souvenir...

original: あそこも大分生態系のバランスが\n崩れてきているみたいで、\nうまく見つけられなかったんだ
traducao: It seems the ecosystem there is\nalso losing its balance,\nso I couldn't find any.

original: そんなの、気にしないキュ！\nジェイが来てくれただけで十分だキュ！
traducao: Don't worry about that, kyu!\nJust having Jay here is enough, kyu!

original: そうだキュ！\n元気を出すキュ！
traducao: That's right, kyu!\nCheer up, kyu!

original: ジェイも、これからここで\nキュッポ達と頑張るキュ！
traducao: Jay will do his best here with\nKyuppo and the others, kyu!

original: ……わかったよ。\nありがとう、みんな
traducao: ...I understand.\nThanks, everyone.

original: ところで……ポッポ？
traducao: By the way... Poppo?

original: 何だキュ？
traducao: What is it, kyu?

original: ぼくの、その……、\n特徴についてなんだけど……
traducao: About my...\ncharacteristics...

original: ……ううん。\n何でもないんだ。\nごめんよ
traducao: ...No.\nIt's nothing.\nSorry.

original: それでは、○○さん。\nこれからよろしくお願いします
traducao: Well then, ○○.\nI look forward to working with you.

original: 何かあれば、\nいつでも声をかけて下さい
traducao: If you need anything,\njust call for me.
